subject: 2024-2025 Governing Agenda and Committee Reorganization
overview: The Council organized for the 2024-2025 term, electing leadership and appointing a City Messenger before adopting a new standing committee structure and a comprehensive governing agenda framework. The body also finalized the city's solid waste ordinance and a major water system bond order.

items.title: Election of Council Leadership and Appointments
items.summary: Elected Councilor Isaac “Zac” Bears as President and Councilor Kit Collins as Vice President; Lawrence Lepore was appointed City Messenger.

items.title: Adoption of Rules and Transfer of Papers
items.summary: Approved adopting prior standing committee rules and transferring all active papers and committees from the 2023 session to the 2024 session.

items.title: Subcommittee Report on Budget Ordinance
items.summary: Approved a report from the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules regarding reconciliation of the draft budget ordinance with the administration.

items.title: Resolutions of Condolence
items.summary: Approved resolutions of condolence for the families of James Jack McDevitt, Judith Granara, and Ernest “Ernie” Artelino.

items.title: Special Permit for Mailings Restaurant
items.summary: Approved a special permit for extended hours of operation at 434A Salem Street with 30 and 60-day reviews.

items.title: 2024-2025 Council Governing Agenda
items.summary: Approved a resolution establishing a framework for council priorities over the next two years, with councilors to submit project items by January 18.

items.title: Establishment of Standing Committees
items.summary: Approved amending Rule 33 to create seven new standing committees focused on functional areas of government like finance, governance, and public safety.

items.title: City Fee Schedule Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution to review and update the municipal fee schedule to the Planning and Permitting Committee.

items.title: Winter Eviction Moratorium
items.summary: Referred a request to the Board of Health to declare a state of emergency and implement a winter eviction moratorium to protect unhoused residents from extreme cold.

items.title: Good Landlord Tax Credit
items.summary: Referred a proposal to explore a property tax credit for landlords who provide below-market rents to the Administration and Finance Committee.

items.title: Wellington Circle Study Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Traffic and Transportation Director requesting a status report on the MassDOT project development process for Wellington Circle.

items.title: Public Participation: Migrant Shelter and High School Track
items.summary: Council heard concerns regarding a potential state-run shelter at 400 Riverside Avenue and a health-hazard warning regarding the deteriorating indoor track at Medford High School.

items.title: Final Approval: Water Bond and Solid Waste Ordinance
items.summary: Approved the third reading of the City Water System Bond Order and ordained the updated Solid Waste Ordinance.
